reviews.author: Relentlessly Tim
reviews.text: I had Delta concrete corporation pour a concrete pad for a large 19 x 12’ shed. Based on the grade or slope of my property, they ended up having to pour an extra thick pad. They did a good job on the pad, but the ramp was a bit off. What was so great about them is that they acknowledged the error and came back and took care of it at no charge to me. They’re easy to work with and communicate well. I will use them again and would recommend them.
